paragraphs.cn: 委内瑞拉行贿嫌疑人被捕

paragraphs.en: A businessman wanted in the U.S. for allegedly paying bribes to top Venezuelan officials in exchange for lucrative state contracts in Venezuela has been taken into custody. Alvaro Pulido was indicted in Miami federal court in 2019 and again in 2021 as part of an investigation into his long-time business partner, Alex Saab, a onetime ally of ousted President Nicolas Maduro.
paragraphs.cn: 一名因涉嫌向委内瑞拉高级官员行贿以换取该国有利可图的政府合同而被美国通缉的商人已被拘留。阿尔瓦罗·普利多于2019年和2021年两次在迈阿密联邦法院被起诉，这些指控源于对其长期商业伙伴亚历克斯·萨阿布的调查；萨阿布曾是被罢免的委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的盟友。
